name: Houtini LM
description: MCP server that connects any MCP client to an OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint. Offload routine analysis to a sidekick model and preserve your primary model's context window.

environmentVariables.name: HOUTINI_LM_ENDPOINT_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible API endpoint (e.g. http://localhost:1234, https://openrouter.ai/api). Legacy alias: LM_STUDIO_URL.

environmentVariables.name: HOUTINI_LM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for API authentication (no auth if blank). Legacy aliases: LM_STUDIO_PASSWORD, LM_PASSWORD, OPENROUTER_API_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: HOUTINI_LM_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Model identifier to use for requests (auto-detected if not set). Legacy alias: LM_STUDIO_MODEL.

environmentVariables.name: HOUTINI_LM_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Optional provider override: 'openrouter' or 'deepseek'. Auto-detected from the endpoint URL when possible.

environmentVariables.name: HOUTINI_LM_ORCHESTRATOR
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'codex' to expose the compact delegate-only tool surface and Codex-specific guidance.

environmentVariables.name: HOUTINI_LM_DEEPSEEK_THINKING
environmentVariables.description: Default DeepSeek thinking mode: disabled, enabled, or auto. The Codex delegate tool may override it per call.

environmentVariables.name: HOUTINI_LM_AUTO_MAX_TOKENS
environmentVariables.description: Hard output-token ceiling. Defaults to 4096; Codex deployments commonly use 1800.

environmentVariables.name: HOUTINI_LM_MAX_INPUT_CHARS
environmentVariables.description: Hard character ceiling for one Codex delegate request. Use it to prevent accidental whole-repository or generated-PCB uploads.

environmentVariables.name: HOUTINI_LM_RESPONSE_METADATA
environmentVariables.description: Response footer mode: none, compact, or full. Delegate responses never include a footer.

environmentVariables.name: HOUTINI_LM_ALLOWED_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated directories allowed for path-based delegation.
